headline: Good morning, Frankie — this one reaches you on time, at breakfast on the coast, which the AM edition could not: it fired twelve hours late and landed at your midnight. So start here, because it is the same fact the AM opened on and it has not moved in the right direction. Phase V2 has been live since 1:00 PM Saturday — the new instant form with SMS OTP, state, age, an appointment-time picker and a required consent checkbox, on the $200 tranche. That is the most compliance-shaped thing this funnel has ever shipped and it is worth saying so. The watchdog has now run eighteen hours straight, every kill gate green: V2 spend $56.65 of $200, lifetime $262.04, twenty-two leads. But the single thing that matters today is the same one from this morning, now older: the one V2 lead Meta recorded — a real, OTP-verified person who chose a time to be called — is still sitting in Meta with no "NEW LEAD CAPTURED" email behind it, and the gap is now past three hours across six consecutive watchdog runs. The last capture email of any kind was September 2. The form-to-sheet-to-n8n-to-email path did not fire for the new form. Frankie, the one move before your coffee gets cold: open Leads Center, download that lead by hand, and honor the time they picked — speed-to-lead is already gone, the appointment is not. Chitraksh: the new form is almost certainly a new form ID the capture webhook was never subscribed to — wire it, confirm the sheet row, and prove it with one real submit before the next lead lands. Two things behind that, both lighter than they looked this morning. "Honest broker" is now confirmed at zero delivery for eighteen hours — past the six-hour threshold — so it is leaking nothing; it stays a form question, not a live risk, until it delivers. And the standing kill candidate, "New Leads Ad …6610018" at $32 and zero leads, is real but frozen behind the 72-hour no-touch window that runs to Tuesday 1:00 PM PT — review only, no action. Last and unchanged: compliance is still 0/7 while the campaign dials, HQ still has no written copy of the V2 plan, and there has been no word from you in the mailbox since August 28 — though you have twice acted straight in the tools, so this is a note, not a nag.

The watchdog has now flagged the break across six straight runs (08:38Z → 13:39Z), each confirming the gap has persisted well past two hours — it is now over three. Speed-to-lead on this person is gone; the appointment slot they picked is the only thing left to save. Frankie: Leads Center → download the lead → call at the time they chose, today.
